fields.label: Region
fields.description: Source of truth; Proxy/Inference Servers on this machine inherit it. Derived from Subnet Group when one is linked and has a Region set.

fields.label: Subnet Group
fields.description: AWS: drives this box's subnet, security groups and region. Bare-metal: optional — a bare-metal box's ports are open by default, so this can point at a placeholder Subnet Group with everything left blank, or stay unset.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Active
Draining
Offline
Terminated

fields.label: Cloud Provider
fields.description: Provider to use for provisioning (e.g. AWS). Blank = manual/on-prem.

fields.label: SSH Key
fields.description: Key authorised on this box. Blank = the control plane's own local key (what Ansible connects with by default).

fields.label: Cloud (AWS)
fields.description: Launch spec for this box. Blank fields fall back to the Cloud Provider's account-wide default.

fields.label: Instance Type
fields.description: e.g. g6.12xlarge. Its GPUs seed the table below at provision.

fields.label: Root Volume (GB)
fields.description: The only disk attached. Holds the OS, the engine images AND the model weights, so size it for every model this box will serve — weights are hundreds of GB and the local NVMe is not used for them.

fields.label: Security Group Role
fields.description: Which of the Subnet Group's two security-group lists this box launches with.

fields.label: Instance Store Disks
fields.description: Ephemeral local NVMe this instance type ships. Wiped on stop and terminate — survives a reboot only. Grove leaves it unmounted and puts nothing on it; it is reported here so you can see the scratch going unused.

fields.label: GPUs
fields.description: GPUs on this box (one row per GPU). On-prem: declare them here, or press Scan GPUs. AWS: seeded from the instance type at provision (no driver on the box yet, so nothing to ask), then replaced by Scan GPUs once Setup has installed one — nvidia-smi is the truth and overwrites, never merges.
